The `catalog` console has adopted t
he `ui.*` extension components (`ui.EntityList`, `ui.EntityItem`, `ui.DetailSurface`, `ui.PropertyGrid`, `ui.Table`, `ui.TableRow`), deleting duplicated inline `style: {}` objects, hex literal

s, and manual lifecycle branches.

The comprehensive report has been committed to [`agent-runs/reports/8-adopt-ui-in-catalog.md`](file:///home/ubuntu/code/mesh-core-dispatch-8/agent-runs/reports/8-adopt-ui-in-catalog.md).

1. **Styles & Hex Literals Removed**:
   - **17 inline `style: {}` objects deleted** across `partsList.ts`, `versionTable.ts`, and `versionProvenanceCard.ts`.
   - **29 hard-coded hex literals deleted** (`#58a6ff

`, `#21262d`, `#30363d`, `#161b22`, `#8b949e`, `#f85149`, `#e6edf3`, etc.), replaced with theme tokens (`var(--ink)`, `var(--ink-dim)`, `var(--accent)`, `var(--surface)`, `var(--chrome)`).
   - **7 manual lifecycle `when()` bran

ches eliminated** (`when(loading)`, `when(error)`, `when(empty)`), replaced by CSS-driven component lifecycle states (`status`, `loadingMessage`, `errorMessage`, `emptyMessage`).
   - **10 `props: { bold:

true }` declarations deleted** in the property grid, replaced by semantic definition styling in `ui.PropertyGrid`.

2. **Consumer-Driven Gaps Identified & Fixed in `ui`** (Commit [`88ff2ac`](
ached an empty `<header>` and `<h2 class="ui-entity-list-heading">` even when no `title` was supplied. Although hidden with `display: none`, the empty heading remained

in the DOM, hijacking heading queries like `querySelector('h2')` and polluting the document outline. Refactored using a `WeakMap<Element, HTMLElement>` to only attach the header when `title` is non-empty

and remove it when falsy.
   - **Selector Mismatch in `ui.PropertyGrid`**: `ui.css` previously targeted `[data-code="true"]`. Because the kernel's built-in `Span` component renders `props: { code: true }` as a boolea

n attribute `data-code=""`, code spans failed to match. Added the `.ui-property-grid [data-code]` selector to [`src/ui/ui.css`](file:///home/ubuntu/code/mesh-core-dispatch-8/src/ui/ui.css#L267).
   - **De

tail Surface Reactivity**: With `ui.DetailSurface` managing visibility via CSS instead of unmounting the subtree, children of `ui.PropertyGrid` remain mounted; property values were refactored into reactive getters (`

() => app.selectedVersion()?.repository ?? ...`) rather than one-time closures.
